status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Sergi, please review fix for this issue in branch ignite-2542.

Added test reproducing issue. NPE was possible for 'dummy' index which does not initialize table. Method GridMergeTable.checkSourceNodesAlive just access related GridMergeIndex, so I moved this method to GridMergeIndex class.
I see too much changes if I compare it to master, thats why I'm asking. Looks like something is wrong.
Please try to merge master to ignite-2542 before comparing, there shouldn't be any conflicts (I just merged it).
